market.question: Will Gold (GC) hit (HIGH) $5,000 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: Gold ~$4,630 in late March; LongForecast sees ~$5,041 by early May. JPM Q4 target ~$5,000, Goldman year-end $5,400. Market needs a CME settlement >=$5,000 on any trading day through end-June. With 2 months and a rising trend, a ~8% move to $5k is well within typical 2-month gold ranges. Slightly favored.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether the recent pullback continues or fresh safe-haven flow re-ignites.
